messages.subject: CPD - 'Whistleblowing after the 2025 cases' (lunch session, 18 Mar)
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

The Employment team is hosting a CPD lunch session on recent whistleblowing and protected-disclosure case law on Wednesday 18 March, 12:30-13:30 in the Bishopsgate training room. Sandwiches provided. 1 hour CPD. Please reply to me if you'd like a place as numbers are limited.

Donna
Donna Bridges | Practice Assistant
